rationale: Calculated three-phase short-circuit currents at near bus (9.305 kA), mid-feeder (3.005 kA), and remote end (1.742 kA) by summing source, transformer, and feeder impedances. Maximum 3-phase is 9.305 kA; minimum 2-phase (√3/2 ratio) is 1.508 kA at remote end. Breaker rating 12.5 kA is the smallest standard rating exceeding 9.305 × 1.1 = 10.236 kA safety margin. Relay pickup 600 A satisfies load margin (≥450 A) and fault sensitivity (≤754 A).
